behavioral_signatures: Automatic scanning of all new or cached artifacts for vulnerabilities before allowing download
Blocking artifact downloads based on detected vulnerability severity
Immediate notification and blocking of artifacts with critical or major vulnerabilities
file_indicators: Artifacts flagged with vulnerability metadata (e.g., Xray scan results)
Artifacts blocked from download with warning banners in repository browsers
network_indicators: REST API calls to Artifactory that fail due to blocked artifacts
Xray service network activity for vulnerability database updates and scan triggers
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor repository management systems (e.g., JFrog Artifactory) for artifacts that are flagged or blocked due to vulnerability scans. Look for automated scan triggers on artifact upload or cache, and track REST API error messages indicating blocked downloads. Review repository browser notifications for blocked artifacts and correlate with Xray scan results and severity thresholds.
